scope: Chromium candidate comparison only; partial asset coverage, not a complete art A/B or Gate 1 approval

pixel32Map.title: Dewhollow pixel32 map and tileset candidate

source.method: hand-authored integer pixel primitives; fixed stored-DEFLATE PNG encoding

limitations: Candidate preview only; not approved or registered as production assets.
Seasonal variants and autotile masks are hand-authored visual studies, not production game map rules.
Building and canopy demonstrate layer ordering and do not alter collision or map data.
Final colors, tile readability, seamless edges, building silhouette, and mobile readability require Gate 1 human review.

pixel32Animation.title: Dewhollow pixel32 four-direction animation candidate
limitations: Candidate art and motion only; not approved or registered as production assets.
Right-facing frames mirror left-facing poses; Gate 1 visual review must confirm silhouette and foot contact.
The preview tool overlay demonstrates timing only and does not change farming rules.
Pixel16 candidate uses the 8-bit atlas scaled to the shared 64 px world tile; pixel32 uses its dedicated seasonal map and animation atlases.
Pixel32-only house/tree overlays and full four-direction player animation do not have equivalent pixel16 candidate frames.
Actual sprite sources are grouped by texture and frame; generic candidateArt resolver IDs do not by themselves represent the pixel32 runtime override coverage.
Chromium CSS-scale screenshots do not establish native device appearance, art quality approval or Gate 1 completion.
